sql: SELECT 'receipt' AS what, command_id||' '||action||' '||status AS k, to_char(started_at,'HH24:MI:SS')||' :: '||COALESCE(left(error,200), left(result_json::text,500),'-') AS v FROM experiment_os_experiment_commands WHERE command_id LIKE 'recut-contestcap%' UNION ALL SELECT 'twins', twin_tag||' <- '||live_tag, 'start='||to_char(started_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI')||' end='||COALESCE(to_char(ended_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI'),'OPEN') FROM live_paper_twins WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR started_at > now() - interval '1 day' UNION ALL SELECT 'open_deploys', d.deployment_key||' ['||d.kind||']', COALESCE(string_agg(da.strategy_tag,','),'-') FROM experiment_deployments d LEFT JOIN experiment_deployment_arms da ON da.deployment_id = d.id WHERE d.ended_at IS NULL AND d.deployment_key LIKE 'mmsell-contestcap%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
